name: driver
concept: The Innsmouth bus driver, a lean man with the Innsmouth look: narrow head, bulging unblinking eyes, grey-skinned, almost no hair, long arms, a rumpled grey bus company jacket over a yellowed shirt, dark trousers, a peaked driver's cap.
description: Lean grey-skinned man with a narrow head, bulging pale eyes, almost no hair, long arms, rumpled grey bus company jacket over a yellowed shirt, dark trousers, peaked driver's cap.
